BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
